corrections.reason: The printed glyph in ወኃጥእት has the two bottom legs of 6th-order እ (ኃጥእት), not ዕ.
Both visually on the page and in canonical Ge'ez (Luke 7:37), the word is printed ኃጥእት with 6th-order እ.
The cross-reference for Mary anointing Jesus's feet with ointment of spikenard is John 12:3 (ዮሐ ፲፪ ፫), and three horizontal strokes are visible in the numeral.
In Luke 7:39, the Ge'ez conditional verb is እምአእመረኑ ('would he not have known', from አእመረ), and the third character in the image is clearly 6th-order እ, misread as ያ due to ink bleed.
The printed Ge'ez word for 'fifty' (Luke 7:41) begins with ኀ (ኀምሳ), not ሃ.
The alternative Ge'ez reading cited before the Amharic gloss 'ዕውነት ፈረድህ' is አማነ ፈታሕከ ('truly you have judged'), with the 4th-order loop on ማ clearly visible.
